page.heading: Get In Touch
page.intro: WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us — send us your laptop model or question and we'll usually reply within minutes during business hours. Prefer to call or email? That works too.

faqs.a: WhatsApp. We reply fastest there, especially if you include your laptop model or a photo of the sticker under your laptop.
Monday to Saturday, 8:00 to 18:00. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next business day.
